title: The lifecycle is a loop, not a waterfall
caption: Six stages, one artifact per edge: targets → dataset → reproducible artifact → manifest → endpoint → drift evidence → back upstream. The shaded bottom half is the operational phase — deployment starts a phase rather than ending one.

title: The day-153 cascade
caption: Five months of dependent decisions harden before the 500 MB constraint arrives at deployment. The rework arrows propagate back to every stage whose artifacts assumed a feasible target — revise, repeat, re-validate.

title: The contract walk-back
caption: Ownership is assigned by boundary, not by discovery site: deployment found the 4 GB defect, evaluation's contract was met, model development received no budget — so the fix starts at problem definition, the earliest boundary whose contract never stated the condition.
